name: Micah Stein
source:
The eldest daughter of the founder of Pogranichnoye. 

Antisocial and unpredictable. Micah lives by her own cruel laws, believing in the supremacy of strength and the inevitability of fate. She acts on pure impulse, driven by boredom and fleeting desires, remaining the most enigmatic and dangerous of the sisters.
